name: Actual Budget
title: Actual Budget: free YNAB alternative
hook: YNAB charges you one hundred and nine dollars a year to budget your money. This app does it for free.

features.say: It's envelope budgeting. Split your income into categories, and only budget cash you have.
Import transactions, sort them, and track recurring bills with schedules.
Reports show your net worth and cash flow.

caption:
YNAB charges $109/year. Actual Budget budgets your money for free 💸

✅ Envelope budgeting: give every dollar a job
✅ Import transactions and track recurring bills with schedules
✅ Net worth and cash flow reports
✅ Works offline, you own your data

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The desktop app works on its own. Syncing across devices needs a server you host yourself, and automatic bank sync only works in some regions (EU/UK, US/Canada).
